title: introduce-credential-orchestra-and-ergonomic-stream-adapters-multi-sdk-bump
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs implemented ad-hoc credential refresh + stream adapters which caused subtle parity bugs and developer confusion. This PR introduces a lightweight Credential Orchestra (a single coordination surface and policy registry) and ergonomic stream adapters for TypeScript async generators, Python async iterators, and Go channel-based consumers. It also publishes coordinated SDK version bumps and small docs/samples. Summary of changes: 1) credential/orchestra: new orchestrator that exposes a pluggable policy interface (rotate/prefetch/fallback) and telemetry hooks to emit credential events for tracing and audit. 2) sdk-ts: add async-generator->pullstream adapter, new retry presets that bind to credential profile, bump ts-sdk to v1.6.3. 3) sdk-py: introduce typed async iterator wrappers that surface credential hints + backoff presets, bump py-sdk to v0.9.7. 4) sdk-go: add channel-friendly stream adapter with context-aware cancel and a compact credential adapter, bump go-sdk to v1.5.2. 5) tests and e2e: cross-sdk integration tests that validate failover, token rotation during long-lived streams, and telemetry emissions. 6) docs: new design doc and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: default policies preserve existing behavior; users can opt in to the new orchestrator by providing a policy registry when constructing the client. Checklist: - [x] Design doc attached and discussed in ENG-1182 - [x] Unit tests for each SDK adapter - [x] Crosslang e2e validating rotation under load - [x] Telemetry and debug logs verified - [x] Release notes drafted Testing notes: ran full CI, flake on integration test "stream-token-rotation" was investigated and mitigated by increasing retry windows; reran the e2e twice. Rollout plan: squash-merge to main, coordinate SDK package publishes in next release train. Migration notes: examples provided for migrating custom token providers to the new policy interface. Links: Linear ENG-1182 design thread; minimal user-facing examples moved to docs/sdk-migration/credential-orchestra.md
commits: initial: add credential orchestra core and interfaces || ts: async-generator adapter + retry presets + version bump v1.6.3 || py: iterator facade + credential hints + tests + bump v0.9.7 || go: channel adapter + context cancel + bump v1.5.2 || docs: design doc and migration examples || tests: cross-sdk e2e and CI fixes
review_comments: Miguel Ortega: Nice consolidation. Two asks: (1) can we reduce surface area of the public policy interface (it looks like we expose too many internal methods); (2) add a small perf benchmark that measures overhead of orchestration under 1000TPS. Asha: responded that public interface trimmed and added a microbenchmark under integration/benchmarks/cred-orch-bench.ts.
Rina Sato: Telemetry looks good but the event names collide with existing auth.events namespace. Please rename to auth.orch.*. Asha: renamed events and updated docs and tests accordingly.

Evan Cole: Go adapter uses a buffered channel of size 4 by default which caused backlog in one test. Suggest making buffer configurable via client opts. Asha: made buffer size configurable and defaulted to 1 for low-latency consumers.

QA (Leah Kim): found intermittent failure where token rotation happened during partial chunk ACK; added e2e that reproduces and validated fix. Asha: added retry + idempotency guard in the stream adapter and test.
release_notes: Introduce Credential Orchestra: a pluggable credential policy registry for coordinated refresh, prefetch and fallback across SDKs. Add ergonomic stream adapters: TS async-generator adapter, Python async-iterator facade, Go channel adapter. SDK bumps: ts v1.6.3, py v0.9.7, go v1.5.2. Backwards compatible by default. See docs/sdk-migration/credential-orchestra.md for migration steps.
